prompt: Polish the tutorial in the Splice project {project}. The screen take shows a private email address in its top-right corner: blur it out for the whole take. Add a lower-third reading 'Ada Lovelace' with the subtitle 'Engineer' early in the take, add a chapter marker named 'Setup' where the take starts, and zoom the take in smoothly from 1x to 1.4x over its first two seconds. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: email blurred
checks.expr: any(e['type'] == 'mask' and e['params'].get('mode', 'blur') in ('blur', 'pixelate', 'cover') and e['params'].get('x', 0.5) >= 0.4 and e['params'].get('y', 0.5) <= 0.35 for c in take_clips() for e in c['effects'])

checks.name: lower third
checks.expr: any(e['type'] == 'template' and e['params'].get('name') == 'lower-third' for i in items for e in i['effects']) and any('Ada' in i['params'].get('text', '') for i in items if i['kind'] == 'title')

checks.name: chapter marker
checks.expr: any(m['name'].strip().lower() == 'setup' and abs(m['at'] - 120) <= 15 for m in project['markers'])

checks.name: keyed zoom
checks.expr: any(e['type'] == 'transform' and isinstance(e['params'].get('scale'), dict) and max(k['value'] for k in e['params']['scale']['keys']) >= 1.35 for c in take_clips() for e in c['effects']) or any(i['kind'] == 'zoom' and i['params'].get('amount', 1) >= 1.35 for i in items)
